series.title: Oakhaven Adventures

questGiver.name: Old Man Kaelen
questGiver.why: He sells the nectar and he sent Malakor into the grove. The job starts at his counter.

series.mayorFrame: Only level 1 and level 10 are the mayor's quests. This module's giver is the NPC in questGiver. Do not move this job onto the mayor's desk.

setup.pitch: Oakhaven's apothecary sends the party into the Whispering Hollow for Gloom-Lily Nectar, but the ancient weaving grove is choking beneath a shadow blight and its druid guardian, Malakor, is bound to the corruption.
setup.openingLocation: Kaelen's Apothecary on Oakhaven's eastern lane
setup.gmSummary: Kaelen needs four vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar before the Hollow's shroud spoils the crop. The party crosses a razor-vine path guarded by blight-twisted shrubs, rot-blooms, and a corrupted bear, opens a sunken druidic shrine by restoring the cycle Decay → Balance → Growth, then enters the Heart Chamber. The Heart Tree Core shields Malakor until fire or radiant energy breaks it. The party can kill Malakor, or cleanse him through three successful cleansing actions before two failures once the core is exposed. The Shroud has three visible stages; rushing or repeated mistakes can make the grove a lasting dead zone even if Malakor falls. Pace: hook at the shop, a rolled lane encounter, a clearer ridge direction with a false north-wood sale, a second roll on the ridge, arrival at the bramble trap and the moonstone puzzle, Malakor holding the nectar, the walk back to Kaelen, and the watchtower lead.
setup.background: The Whispering Hollow is an old druidic weaving grove where roots, moonlight, and seasonal magic were once braided into healing plants. Malakor has tended it long enough to know individual trees by scar and season, leaves bundles of dried Gloom-Lily for Kaelen without being asked, and refuses to cut living wood when deadfall will do. Weeks ago he found a black splinter embedded in the Heart Tree and tried to draw the sickness into himself rather than let it spread into Oakhaven. The corruption instead used him as an anchor. In lucid moments he still repeats the old tending cycle—Decay, Balance, Growth—and apologizes to the grove before the blight forces him to attack. Kaelen knows only that his Gloom-Lilies have stopped arriving and that the Hollow's birds no longer cross the eastern ridge.
pregenTieIns: Fighter: hold narrow lanes, protect the cleansing attempt, and break the bear's thorn binding.
Rogue: cross razor-vines safely, inspect shrine mechanisms, and recover hidden offerings.
Cleric: radiant damage can expose the Heart Tree Core and Religion can drive the cleansing ritual.
Wizard or Sorcerer: area control helps against clustered thorn-shrubs; Arcana can operate the Moonstone Pillars.

quest.objective: Recover four usable vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar and stop the shadow corruption spreading from the Heart Tree.
quest.stakes: If the shroud reaches its third stage before the corruption is broken, the Hollow becomes a lasting dead zone and most of the Gloom-Lilies spoil.
quest.deadline: SHROUD 0–3: mark one surge after the Bramble Guard; mark one for a failed/forced shrine solution; mark one if the party takes a long delay. At 3, the grove cannot fully recover tonight.
successConditions: The Heart Tree Core is destroyed or purified.
At least one usable Gloom-Lily harvest is recovered.
failureConditions: The party leaves the Heart Tree corruption active.
The Shroud reaches 3 before the corruption is broken, causing the Hollow to remain a dead zone even after Malakor is stopped.

facts.text: Malakor did not create the blight deliberately; he tried to draw a black splinter's corruption out of the Heart Tree and became its living anchor.
The Heart Tree Core is the source of Malakor's ward and can be harmed only by fire or radiant energy until exposed and broken.
Malakor can be cleansed alive once the Core is exposed; killing him is not required to end the corruption.
The Hollow's corruption is advancing in three visible Shroud stages. Reaching stage 3 makes the dead zone persist even if the immediate threat is stopped.
Malakor carried a marked map pointing to caverns beneath Oakhaven's eastern watchtower.
Malakor is still intermittently himself beneath the blight: he remembers the grove's tending cycle, recognizes Kaelen's name, and deliberately fights the corruption when given a chance.

secrets.text: The black splinter in the Heart Tree was placed from below through an old root fissure connected to deeper caverns.
secrets.revealCondition: Inspect the exposed Heart Tree wound after the Core breaks or study Malakor's marked map.

npcs.name: Old Man Kaelen
voiceCues: uses plant names instead of vague descriptions
wants: Four clean vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar
The Hollow saved if that can be done without losing the harvest
fears: Sending adventurers into a corruption he does not understand
knows: The lilies grow near the Heart Tree
The eastern birds stopped entering the Hollow three days ago
Malakor was once the Hollow's caretaker
believes: Malakor may be in trouble rather than simply hostile
cannotKnow: Whether Malakor can still be cleansed

revealRules.when: The party asks who normally tends the grove.

revealRules.fact: The nectar must be gathered after the corruption is broken.
revealRules.when: The party asks how to harvest safely.

npcs.questFunction: Gives the objective, the harvesting jars, and the first reason not to assume Malakor is willingly evil.
npcs.description: A stooped apothecary with silver hair tied in twine, stained fingertips, and four stoppered green-glass vials already lined up on the counter.
tableDialogue: “Four vials. Clean nectar, not whatever black syrup the Hollow is making now.”
“Malakor tended that grove longer than I've tended this shop. If he's the problem, find out why before you make him the solution.”
“Bring me the nectar, and bring yourselves back with it.”

reactions.agreement: Hands over four empty vials, a pruning knife, and a charcoal sketch of the Heart Tree trail.
reactions.refusal: Offers half the bounty up front only if they will at least inspect the grove and report what changed.
reactions.accusation: Admits he is withholding no cure; he genuinely does not know what poisoned the Hollow.
reactions.danger: Bars his shutters, moves customers to the cellar, and tells the party which eastern lane stays clear.

npcs.name: Malakor the Blight-Touched
npcs.role: corrupted druid guardian and finale antagonist
voiceCues: speaks through clenched teeth when lucid
the corruption repeats the last word of his sentences in a second whisper
wants: Keep outsiders away from the Heart Tree
In lucid moments, sever himself from the corruption before it spreads
fears: The black splinter reaching Oakhaven's roots
Killing someone while under the shroud's control
knows: He tried to absorb the blight
Fire and radiant force tear open the shadow ward
The old shrine can focus cleansing energy
believes: If he dies before the Core breaks, the corruption may simply choose another anchor
secrets: A root fissure beneath the Heart Tree leads toward the eastern watchtower caverns
cannotKnow: Who placed the black splinter below the grove

revealRules.when: The Core is exposed and a character reaches him with a successful cleansing action or direct appeal.

npcs.questFunction: Provides a dangerous but optional-to-kill finale and the link to Module 03.
npcs.description: A once-green-robed druid wrapped in black root filaments, with one hand fused to a crooked staff and pale light leaking through cracks in his bark-darkened skin.
tableDialogue: “Stay back. It hears through the roots.”
“Burn the heart's wound—not the tree. Not the tree.”
“Below us. Something pushed the splinter up from below.”

reactions.agreement: If the party begins a cleansing attempt, Malakor spends his lucid moments fighting the roots instead of the characters.
reactions.refusal: The corruption takes control and he orders the grove to drive them out.
reactions.accusation: He admits he touched the splinter willingly but insists he was trying to contain it.
reactions.danger: He protects the Heart Tree first, even while the corruption uses him against the party.

locations.name: Kaelen's Apothecary
locations.description: A narrow timber shop crowded with drying herbs, copper kettles, and glass jars; bitter lavender hangs in the warm air while rain ticks against the eastern shutters.

locations.name: The Bramble Guard
locations.description: A sixty-foot woodland lane twists between root walls and blackthorn thickets. Necrotic mist hugs the ground, needle clusters twitch overhead, and every exposed vine seems sharpened.

locations.name: The Sunken Shrine
locations.description: Three moonstone pillars rise from a moss-filled depression beneath a broken stone canopy. Thin shafts of sunlight strike movable mirrors while cold water circles the floor.

locations.name: The Heart Tree Chamber
locations.description: A vast hollow oak fills a circular grove seventy feet across. Black roots pulse beneath silver bark, Gloom-Lilies ring a split trunk, and Malakor stands inside a breathing veil of shadow.

locations.name: Oakhaven's eastern lane
locations.description: The eastern lane is a rutted dirt road between mint hedges and a drainage ditch. It smells of wet ash, horse sweat, and crushed leaves. A lichen-green milestone stands at the fork, papered with overlapping notices.

locations.name: Ridge road to the Hollow
locations.description: The ridge road climbs through oak shade toward the Whispering Hollow. Ferns slap at the knees, bird calls stop in patches, and old charcoal blazes mark the trees Kaelen uses when the path is vague.

scenes.title: Four Empty Vials
scenes.purpose: Give the objective, establish Malakor as a former caretaker, and put the Shroud clock on the table before the party leaves town.
scenes.readAloud: Kaelen's shop smells of crushed mint, hot copper, and something medicinal enough to sting your eyes. Four empty green-glass vials stand in a perfect row beside an old map of Oakhaven's eastern woods. Kaelen taps the marked hollow with one stained fingernail. “The Gloom-Lilies are still in there. The people who tend them are not coming out.”
gmNotes: Kaelen offers 150 gp total for four clean vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar.
He tells the party Malakor was the Hollow's caretaker; he does not know Malakor is corrupted.
Put three boxes labeled SHROUD on the table. The adventure starts at 0/3.
The nectar is safe to harvest only after the Heart Tree corruption is broken.

Quest giver: Old Man Kaelen. If someone says Malakor's name over an empty vial, the glass fogs and the word Balance shows in the condensation, then fades. That is a strange hook, not the shrine's solution.

runSteps.title: Give the job
runSteps.text: State the 150 gp bounty, four-vial target, and 2–3 hour urgency.

runSteps.title: Humanize Malakor
runSteps.text: If asked, Kaelen says Malakor protected the grove for years and may be a victim.

runSteps.title: Show the clock
runSteps.text: Place three visible Shroud boxes in front of the players before they leave.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party accepts the vials and heads into the Whispering Hollow.

exitChoices.label: First roll
exitChoices.description: Leave the hook and roll the roadside table.

scenes.title: The Bramble Guard
scenes.purpose: Make the corrupted ecosystem visible, introduce the movement hazard, and let the party rescue or fight a thorn-bound bear while pushing toward the shrine.
scenes.readAloud: The path narrows until the trees become walls. Razor vines drag across stone like fingernails, and gray mist curls around your boots without moving in the wind. Three thornbushes shudder and drag themselves out of the brambles on root-feet as a bear lurches into view, its shoulders cinched by a collar of living black thorns. Beside the lane, two swollen violet-black blooms turn toward the sound of your boots, tendrils uncurling.
gmNotes: Mark SHROUD 1/3 when this encounter ends, whether the party fights, bypasses, or frees the bear.
Razor-Thorns: moving through thorn squares without taking the Cautious Passage action triggers DC 12 Dexterity save; failure deals 1d6 piercing.
Cautious Passage: spend an Action to move up to half speed through razor-vine terrain without making the hazard save.

The bear is bound, not naturally hostile. A character adjacent to it can use an Action and DC 12 Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Wisdom (Animal Handling) to break/loosen the thorn collar; success removes the bear from the fight.
The party only needs to reach the shrine trail. Killing every thorn-shrub and rot-bloom is not required.

runSteps.title: Place the lane
runSteps.text: Use the 80 × 40 ft. battle map. Brambles line both sides; the shrine trail is 60 ft. ahead.

runSteps.title: Run the job
runSteps.text: The goal is to reach the shrine or neutralize the corrupted guard. Offer the bear-collar solution when someone examines it.

runSteps.title: Advance the Shroud
runSteps.text: When the party clears the scene, mark SHROUD 1/3 and describe the fog rising to knee height.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party reaches the stone steps descending to the Sunken Shrine.

exitChoices.label: Descend to the shrine
exitChoices.description: Follow the moonstone steps beneath the bramble canopy.

scenes.title: Decay, Balance, Growth
scenes.purpose: Give the party the clean route into the Heart Chamber, teach that cleansing is possible, and reward preparation with Moonstone Resonance.
scenes.readAloud: The path drops into a round stone basin where three moonstone pillars stand beneath a shattered roof. Their glyphs show a leaf unfurling, a leaf half green and half black, and a bare branch returning to soil. Three tarnished mirrors can be turned toward narrow shafts of sunlight. On the sealed door beyond them, roots have grown around one sentence: WHAT DIES FEEDS WHAT LIVES.
gmNotes: The intended mirror order is Decay → Balance → Growth.
A character can identify the cycle with DC 12 Intelligence (Nature or Arcana). The inscription itself means failure never blocks the answer.
Instead of the mirrors, a character can channel magical/divine power with DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) or Wisdom (Religion) to open the seal.
A wrong alignment triggers Moonstone Backlash. After one wrong attempt, mirror-scratches visibly show the correct sequence; the party can continue.
Solving without a backlash grants Moonstone Resonance: once in the finale, any one character can use an Action to deal 1d8 radiant damage directly to the Heart Tree Core.
The opened alcove contains a Potion of Healing, a Wand of Secrets with 3 charges, and 25 gp in ancient silver.

runSteps.title: Show the three glyphs
runSteps.text: Name them Growth, Balance, and Decay. Let players turn the mirrors in any order.

runSteps.title: Fail forward
runSteps.text: On a wrong order, resolve the backlash, mark one Shroud surge, then reveal the mirror-wear that makes Decay → Balance → Growth clear.

runSteps.title: Pay preparation
runSteps.text: A clean solution grants Moonstone Resonance and opens the offering alcove before the Heart Chamber.

scenes.advanceWhen: The Heart Chamber door opens and the party chooses to enter.

exitChoices.label: Enter the Heart Chamber
exitChoices.description: Carry the shrine's lesson into the corrupted grove.

scenes.title: The Heart Tree
scenes.purpose: Break the Core's protection and choose whether Malakor is killed or cleansed before the Shroud permanently scars the grove.
scenes.readAloud: The Heart Tree fills the clearing like a cathedral column split by lightning. Silver bark peels back from a pulsing black wound, and a knot of shadow the size of a shield beats inside it. Malakor turns toward you with roots braided through his arms. His first word is his own voice; the echo beneath it is not. “Stay back,” he gasps. “It hears through the roots.”
gmNotes: Heart Tree Core: AC 12, 20 HP. Only fire or radiant damage harms it. While it has HP, Malakor is shielded and cannot be reduced below 1 HP.
If the party earned Moonstone Resonance, one character can spend one Action once to deal 1d8 radiant damage directly to the Core.

At initiative count 20, roots burst from the ground. Creatures on the ground make DC 13 Strength saves or become Restrained. A restrained creature or adjacent ally can use an Action and DC 13 Strength (Athletics) to free it.

Once the Core reaches 0 HP, the party may finish Malakor by combat or cleanse him. Cleansing requires 3 successes before 2 failures; each attempt is an Action using DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana or Nature), Wisdom (Medicine or Religion), or Charisma (Persuasion) if the character directly appeals to Malakor.
On a successful cleansing action Malakor loses his next hostile action as he fights the corruption. Three successes ends the encounter with him alive.
If SHROUD reaches 3 before the Core breaks, the finale is still winnable, but the grove remains a dead zone and only two Gloom-Lily vials survive.

Malakor's thematic spell list is Entangle, Thunderwave, and Shillelagh (all SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 spells). If using full spell text, use the selected ruleset's SRD wording; the quick-run actions are complete without opening another book.

runSteps.title: Expose the job
runSteps.text: Tell the table immediately that attacks slide off Malakor while the black Core is beating; fire or radiant energy can hurt the Core.

runSteps.title: Run the roots
runSteps.text: At initiative 20 each round, resolve the DC 13 root burst and keep the battlefield moving.

runSteps.title: Offer the cleanse
runSteps.text: When the Core breaks, state that Malakor is lucid enough to save. Track 3 cleansing successes before 2 failures if the party chooses that route.

runSteps.title: Choose the consequence
runSteps.text: Use the matching resolution card: Cleansed, Felled, or Shrouded if the clock reached 3 before the Core broke.

scenes.advanceWhen: The Core is broken and Malakor is cleansed or defeated; choose the resolution that matches the Shroud state and Malakor's fate.

exitChoices.label: Malakor cleansed
exitChoices.description: The Core broke before SHROUD 3 and the party completed the cleansing ritual.

exitChoices.label: Malakor defeated
exitChoices.description: The Core broke before SHROUD 3 and Malakor died or was finished in combat.

exitChoices.label: Shroud reached 3
exitChoices.description: The immediate threat ends, but the Hollow remains a lasting dead zone.

scenes.title: Resolution: The Hollow Breathes
scenes.purpose: Close the adventure with Malakor alive, full harvest rewards, and the eastern-watchtower lead.
scenes.readAloud: The last black root snaps loose from Malakor's wrist. For a moment the entire Hollow goes silent; then water begins moving beneath the roots again, and pale Gloom-Lilies open one by one around the Heart Tree. Malakor sinks to his knees and pulls a mud-stained map from inside his robe. A charcoal mark circles Oakhaven's eastern watchtower, with a line drawn beneath it into the earth.
gmNotes: The party can harvest four clean vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar.
Kaelen/Town Council pays 150 gp total and gives the Potion of Greater Healing.
Malakor confirms the black splinter came upward through a root fissure connected to caverns beneath the eastern watchtower.
This is the cleanest hook into Module 03, but do not force immediate travel.

runSteps.title: Harvest
runSteps.text: Give the party four usable vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar.

runSteps.title: Pay the bounty
runSteps.text: On return to Oakhaven, award 150 gp total plus the Potion of Greater Healing.

runSteps.title: Show the next map
runSteps.text: Hand over Malakor's marked watchtower map and end on the underground route.

scenes.advanceWhen: Rewards are recorded and the party decides what to do with the eastern-watchtower map.

exitChoices.label: Return to Kaelen
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Resolution: Roots Without a Keeper
scenes.purpose: Close the adventure after Malakor dies while preserving the full harvest if the Shroud was stopped in time.
scenes.readAloud: When Malakor falls, the black filaments across the Heart Tree recoil into the split trunk and turn to ash. The grove does not celebrate; it simply begins to live again. Beneath Malakor's staff lies a folded map stained with root sap. One charcoal circle marks Oakhaven's eastern watchtower, and beside it someone has written a single word: BELOW.
gmNotes: If the Core broke before SHROUD 3, four clean Gloom-Lily vials survive.
Kaelen/Town Council still pays 150 gp total and grants the Potion of Greater Healing.
Malakor's marked map is found on his body or beneath his staff; Module 03 remains available even if he cannot explain it.
Kaelen is relieved the Hollow is saved but openly mourns the loss of its caretaker.

runSteps.title: Harvest
runSteps.text: Give the party four usable vials of Gloom-Lily Nectar if SHROUD stayed below 3.

runSteps.title: Return
runSteps.text: Award 150 gp total and the Potion of Greater Healing in Oakhaven.

runSteps.title: Reveal below
runSteps.text: Place the marked eastern-watchtower map in the party's hands.

scenes.advanceWhen: Rewards are recorded and the party has the marked map.

exitChoices.label: Return to Kaelen
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Resolution: The Dead Grove
scenes.purpose: Let the adventure finish even after the clock is lost, with reduced harvest and a stronger reason to follow the corruption underground.
scenes.readAloud: The Core finally breaks, but the black fog does not leave. It settles into the lowest roots like ink soaking into cloth. Half the Gloom-Lilies collapse before your eyes; the rest close around beads of dark nectar. Near the split trunk, a root fissure exhales the same cold air as the corruption. Malakor's marked map—or the papers at his feet—points from that fissure toward Oakhaven's eastern watchtower.
gmNotes: Only two usable Gloom-Lily vials survive. Kaelen pays 75 gp for the partial harvest and information.
Do not award the Potion of Greater Healing on this outcome; the Council reserves it for a restored grove.
The Hollow remains a dead zone until the deeper source beneath the eastern watchtower is addressed.
The adventure is complete; failure on the clock changes the world but does not block Module 03.

runSteps.title: Show the cost
runSteps.text: Reduce the harvest to two vials and make the dead-zone consequence visible.

runSteps.title: Partial payment
runSteps.text: Kaelen pays 75 gp for the surviving nectar and the party's report.

runSteps.title: Point underground
runSteps.text: End on the root fissure and marked eastern-watchtower map.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party understands the Hollow remains damaged and has the watchtower lead.

exitChoices.label: Return to Kaelen
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Roll on the Eastern Lane
scenes.purpose: A truly random encounter on the way out of Oakhaven, rolled at the table, before the Hollow's direction is clear.
scenes.readAloud: The eastern lane smells of wet ash and crushed mint. Kaelen's marks stop at a milestone where three tracks argue: the ridge road, a goat path, and the ditch people call the Short Cut. A handcart sits with one wheel off. Somebody has nailed a fresh notice over a faded one. The Hollow is not in sight yet. Roll before anyone picks a road.
gmNotes: Roll 1d6 in the open. Use that row only. This is not a fixed fight.
The row never carries the only copy of a required clue. Skipping it does not stop the night.

1. A carter named Poul asks help with the wheel. DC 10 Strength (Athletics) sets it. Success: he gives a true rumor that birds will not cross the ridge. Failure: the wheel still goes on crooked and he warns you the Short Cut is a lie.
2. The fresh notice says Malakor is selling nectar in the north wood. It is a week old and wrong. Treat it as the red herring, then keep going. The notice is not a required clue.

3. Hungry SRD Black Bear, not a required fight. AC 11, HP 19. 2014: Bite +3 (1d6+2) and Claws +3 (2d4+2). 2024: two Rend attacks +4, 1d6+2 slashing each. Offer food or a DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. Success: it leaves. Failure: it snaps once, then the party can still go around. Do not spend the night here.
4. A child has lost a goat bell, not a goat. Returning it earns no gold and a warning that the ridge has gone quiet. DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) finds the bell in the ditch either way.
5. Slick boards over the ditch. DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) or fall Prone and lose a minute. The road continues.

6. Two SRD Awakened Shrubs in the ditch. AC 9, HP 10, vulnerable to fire, resistant to piercing. Rake +1, 1 slashing. They do not chase. A DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check walks past; on a failure the passer takes 1 slashing and still passes.

exitChoices.label: Read the milestone
exitChoices.description: The rolled row is done and the road continues.

runSteps.title: Roll in the open
runSteps.text: Tell the table this beat is a roll, not a scripted monster. Roll 1d6 where everyone can see it.

runSteps.title: Run only that row
runSteps.text: Read the matching row. If it is the combat row, offer the listed way out before initiative.

runSteps.title: Move on either way
runSteps.text: Success and failure both leave the party able to continue. Do not gate the next scene on this roll.

scenes.advanceWhen: One rolled row has been resolved and the party is moving again.

scenes.title: The Blaze and the False Notice
scenes.purpose: Give a clearer direction to the Heart Tree, and show that the north-wood sale is a red herring.
scenes.readAloud: The milestone at the fork is arguing with itself. A fresh notice, still smelling of paste, says Malakor is selling nectar in the north wood and names a price. A chalk arrow points down the goat path. Charcoal the color of Kaelen's stained fingers marks the ridge, then smears, as if the hand got embarrassed and stopped. In the ditch, a torn scrap shows one word in a tight hand: Decay. The birds will not cross any of the three tracks.
gmNotes: Quest giver is Old Man Kaelen, the apothecary who sells the nectar. The mayor does not give this job. Level 1 and level 10 are the mayor's modules, and they are not written.

Lead A, red herring: the north-wood notice. Motive: a rival stall wants Kaelen's buyers walking the wrong way so the grove trade dies. The paste is old. The stall is empty. Checking it costs about ten minutes.

Lead B: Kaelen himself, if they go back or already pressed him. Motive: shame. He sent Malakor in. He shows how he makes a charcoal blaze only if someone asks how he marks a path. He is not lying about the missing nectar. He is leaving the ridge out.

Lead C, physical: the scrap in the ditch. Dry it or make a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) check and the rest reads Decay, Balance, Growth in Malakor's hand. On a failure the word Decay is still there, and the shrine repeats the cycle later. This scrap is not the only copy of that cycle.
Any order works. Do not announce the ridge as the answer in the first sentence. After they test one false road, the charcoal and the scrap are still on the stone.

exitChoices.label: Take the ridge
exitChoices.description: Follow the blazes. Roll again on the road.

runSteps.title: Put the leads on the table
runSteps.text: Name the people and the physical claims. Let the players choose the order. Do not announce which one is true.

runSteps.title: Play the motive
runSteps.text: Each person wants something. A false lead has a reason. Answer questions in that person's voice.

runSteps.title: Wrong turns fail forward
runSteps.text: Checking the red herring costs about ten minutes. The true route is still in their hands afterward, on paper or on the ground.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party knows the ridge road is the real route and has left the milestone.

scenes.title: Roll on the Ridge Road
scenes.purpose: A second rolled encounter while traveling to the Hollow, before arrival at the brambles.
scenes.readAloud: The ridge road climbs under oaks that should be noisy and are not. Ferns soak your boots. Charcoal blazes keep the path honest, then stop where the light turns the color of old iron. Something moves once, off the trail, and does not call. Roll before the party steps into the brambles.
gmNotes: Roll 1d6 in the open. Use that row only. This is not a fixed fight.
The row never carries the only copy of a required clue. Skipping it does not stop the night.
1. A silent deer crosses and will not be hunted. DC 10 Wisdom (Animal Handling) or it bolts. Either way the party sees it refuse to enter the iron-colored light.

2. Old camp ash and a cold kettle. DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) finds Malakor's herb twist, proof he came this way alive. Failure still leaves the twist in plain sight if they search the kettle.
3. A fallen limb blocks the trail. DC 10 Strength (Athletics) moves it. Failure: go around, lose five minutes, and do not mark a Shroud box unless they camp.

4. Hungry SRD Black Bear, not a required fight. AC 11, HP 19. 2014: Bite +3 (1d6+2) and Claws +3 (2d4+2). 2024: two Rend attacks +4, 1d6+2 slashing each. Offer food or a DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. Success: it leaves. Failure: it snaps once, then the party can still go around. Do not spend the night here.
5. Wind through the canopy sounds like whispering. It is branches. Say so if they ask. No roll required to disbelieve it.

6. Two SRD Awakened Shrubs in the ditch. AC 9, HP 10, vulnerable to fire, resistant to piercing. Rake +1, 1 slashing. They do not chase. A DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check walks past; on a failure the passer takes 1 slashing and still passes.

exitChoices.label: Reach the brambles
exitChoices.description: The rolled row is done and the road continues.

runSteps.title: Roll in the open
runSteps.text: Tell the table this beat is a roll, not a scripted monster. Roll 1d6 where everyone can see it.

runSteps.title: Run only that row
runSteps.text: Read the matching row. If it is the combat row, offer the listed way out before initiative.

runSteps.title: Move on either way
runSteps.text: Success and failure both leave the party able to continue. Do not gate the next scene on this roll.

scenes.advanceWhen: One rolled row has been resolved and the party is moving again.

scenes.title: Back to Kaelen's Counter
scenes.purpose: Travel back to Oakhaven and settle the nectar job with Kaelen, including the permanent magic item.
scenes.readAloud: Oakhaven's eastern lane is louder on the way home. Mint and hot copper meet you at Kaelen's door before he does. He counts the vials with a stained finger, then looks past you, once, as if the grove might have followed. The counter is clear except for a cloth-wrapped wand he did not have out this morning. He waits to hear whether Malakor is still a man.
gmNotes: Pay the bounty that matches the ending already chosen: 150 gp if the corruption broke before Shroud 3, otherwise the partial pay already written on that ending.

Permanent item, both editions: Wand of Secrets, uncommon, 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. SRD 5.2 uses a Magic action. 2014 uses an action; that action name was not re-copied from a 5.1 PDF here. If the shrine wand was missed, Kaelen had this second wand in the shop and gives it now. The party does not get two.

If the grove was restored, he also gives one Potion of Greater Healing (SRD, uncommon, 4d4+4 HP). It is consumable and is not assumed to remain on later sheets. The custom Potion of Greater Healing is not real and is not awarded.

exitChoices.label: Ask what the map means
exitChoices.description: Settle the coin, then take the next lead.

runSteps.title: Count the vials
runSteps.text: Kaelen pays what the ending already earned. Say the number out loud.

runSteps.title: Hand over the wand
runSteps.text: Give one Wand of Secrets and read the charge rule for the table's edition. Do not also give a ring.

runSteps.title: Record Malakor
runSteps.text: Write whether he lived. Oakhaven remembers that answer in the next module.

scenes.advanceWhen: Coin and the Wand of Secrets are recorded, and Kaelen has heard Malakor's fate.

scenes.title: Resolution: The Map under the Tower
scenes.purpose: Close this ending and hand the party the lead into Beneath the Eastern Watchtower.
scenes.readAloud: Kaelen spreads the stained map on the counter and weights the corner with a vial. The charcoal circle is not the Hollow. It sits under Oakhaven's eastern watchtower, with a line drawn down into the earth. He taps it once. “I sell leaves. I do not keep a cellar that draws pictures of itself. Captain Marr will pretend she is not worried. She is.”
gmNotes: This is the series lead, not a new fight. Module 03 is level 3.
If they already have Malakor's map from the Heart Tree, this scene confirms it. If that copy was lost, Kaelen traced a second from the scrap in the ditch and the fissure they described.
The mayor of Oakhaven is the level 1 and level 10 frame of the series and is not in this module. Do not invent a mayor scene tonight.

runSteps.title: Show the circle
runSteps.text: Put the watchtower map in their hands. Name Captain Marr as the next person.

runSteps.title: Say what leveled
runSteps.text: Tell the players this module is worth one level, from 2 to 3, if they are playing the series.

runSteps.title: Stop
runSteps.text: End. Do not start the tower tonight unless the table demands a cliffhanger sentence.

scenes.advanceWhen: The watchtower map is in the party's hands and the session is closing.

clues.revelation: Malakor is an anchor for the corruption, not its deliberate creator.
sources: Kaelen's record of Malakor tending the Hollow peacefully for years.
The thorn-bound bear, thorn-shrubs, and rot-blooms carry the same black root residue wrapped through their bodies.
Malakor's lucid warning in the Heart Chamber tells the party that the roots are controlling him.

clues.revelation: Fire or radiant energy can break the Heart Tree Core that shields Malakor.
sources: Scorched black-root residue on the Bramble Guard trail flakes away where old lantern fire touched it.
The Sunken Shrine inscription and moonstone mechanism describe light burning rot out of the living cycle.
Malakor's lucid words in the Heart Chamber explicitly direct the party to burn the tree's wound rather than the tree.

clues.revelation: Once the Core is exposed, Malakor can be cleansed alive rather than killed.
sources: The Sunken Shrine's Balance inscription depicts a blackened druid standing again after moonlight passes through three pillars.
A physical ritual record carved on the shrine plinth describes three harmonies restoring a corrupted keeper.
After the Core breaks, Malakor becomes lucid between root spasms and asks the party to sever the corruption from him.

clues.revelation: The corruption is connected to caverns beneath Oakhaven's eastern watchtower.
sources: Malakor's marked map circles the eastern watchtower and draws a route below it.
The Heart Tree's exposed root fissure angles east beneath the grove.
If alive, Malakor says the black splinter was pushed upward from below.

encounters.name: The Bramble Guard
encounters.summary: Three blight-twisted Thorn-Shrubs and two Rot-Blooms guard a thorn-bound bear while razor-vines make careless movement dangerous.
encounters.objective: Reach the shrine trail or neutralize the corruption without being trapped in the thorn lane.
encounters.resolution: The scene ends when the party reaches the far steps, all hostile thorn-shrubs and rot-blooms are neutralized, or the bear is freed and a safe route is opened.
encounters.talkOut: The thorn-shrubs and rot-blooms do not negotiate, but the bear can be freed rather than killed.
encounters.bypass: Spend actions on Cautious Passage and move to the shrine steps; burning or cutting a 10-foot bramble section also creates a safe gap.
encounters.special: Freeing the Bramble-Bound Bear removes it from combat immediately; it flees into the uncorrupted woods.

encounters.name: Malakor and the Heart Tree Core
encounters.difficulty: medium (climactic; the Core shield makes it play harder)
encounters.summary: The Core protects Malakor while animated roots control the battlefield. Fire or radiant energy breaks the Core; then the party chooses combat or a three-success cleansing.
encounters.objective: Break the Core and end Malakor's connection to the shadow blight before the grove is permanently scarred.
encounters.resolution: Core at 0 HP plus Malakor defeated or 3 cleansing successes. Two cleansing failures do not end the adventure; Malakor returns to full hostility and the party may keep fighting or try a new approach.
encounters.talkOut: After the Core breaks, a character can use an Action and DC 13 Charisma (Persuasion) as one cleansing attempt by calling Malakor back to himself. Three total cleansing successes before two failures save him.
encounters.bypass: Moonstone Resonance from a clean shrine solution supplies one guaranteed chance to damage the Core even if the party lacks fire or radiant spells.
encounters.special: Initiative count 20 roots force DC 13 Strength saves or Restrained; an Action and DC 13 Athletics frees a restrained creature.

puzzles.name: The Three Moonstone Pillars
puzzles.prompt: Align the mirrors so sunlight strikes the pillars in the order that completes the grove's cycle. The glyphs are Growth, Balance, and Decay; the door reads WHAT DIES FEEDS WHAT LIVES.
puzzles.skillBypass: DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) or Wisdom (Religion) channels enough magical/divine energy through the pillars to open the seal without mirror alignment.
puzzles.failForward: A wrong order triggers Moonstone Backlash and marks one Shroud surge, but fresh mirror-scratches visibly reveal the correct order. The party can immediately try again.

traps.name: Razor-Thorns
traps.trigger: A creature moves through a razor-vine square without using Cautious Passage.
traps.effect: DC 12 Dexterity saving throw; on a failure take 1d6 piercing damage. Success avoids the damage and movement continues.
traps.failForward: Damage never stops movement or blocks the shrine. A character can use an Action for Cautious Passage to move up to half speed through the vines without another save that turn.

items.name: Gloom-Lily Nectar
items.description: Four clean vials on a full victory; two survive if SHROUD reaches 3 before the Core breaks.
items.effect: Kaelen uses the nectar for rare antitoxins and restorative draughts.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: Found in the Sunken Shrine offering alcove.
items.effect: Use the selected 5E ruleset's normal healing potion rules.

items.name: Wand of Secrets
items.description: An old shrine wand with 3 charges.
items.effect: Use the selected ruleset's SRD wording for Wand of Secrets.

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.description: Kaelen's extra payment when the grove is restored. It does not carry onto later sheets.
items.effect: SRD Potion of Greater Healing: regain 4d4+4 HP when drunk. Consumed. The custom Ring of Plant Protection is not awarded.

items.name: Marked Watchtower Map
items.description: A root-stained map pointing to caverns beneath Oakhaven's eastern watchtower.

playMaps.title: Bramble Guard — 80 × 40 ft.
playMaps.caption: Razor-vine lane with shrine steps at the far end.
notes: Two Rot-Blooms are rooted beside the lane behind the northern brambles (reach 10 ft.)
Thorn squares trigger Razor-Thorns unless crossed cautiously

playMaps.title: Heart Tree Chamber — 70 × 70 ft.
playMaps.caption: Circular grove with the Heart Tree Core at center and root lanes radiating outward.
notes: Malakor begins adjacent to the Core
Four root lanes are difficult terrain
South opening is the party entry

events.name: Shroud Rises
events.effect: Mark SHROUD 1/3; fog rises to knee height.

events.name: Moonstone Backlash
events.trigger: First wrong shrine alignment or forced failure
events.effect: Mark one Shroud surge, to a maximum of 3.

events.name: The Hollow Settles
events.trigger: The party takes a long rest or spends an extended delay after entering the Hollow
events.effect: Mark one Shroud surge, to a maximum of 3.

endings.name: The Hollow Breathes
endings.condition: Core broken before SHROUD 3 and Malakor cleansed.
endings.result: Four nectar vials, 150 gp bounty, Potion of Greater Healing, Malakor survives, and the watchtower map points to Module 03.

endings.name: Roots Without a Keeper
endings.condition: Core broken before SHROUD 3 and Malakor dies.
endings.result: Four nectar vials, 150 gp bounty, Potion of Greater Healing, and Malakor's map still reveals the watchtower caverns.

endings.name: The Dead Grove
endings.condition: SHROUD reaches 3 before the Core breaks.
endings.result: Only two nectar vials survive, Kaelen pays 75 gp, the grove remains a dead zone, and the underground source becomes the next urgent lead.

policies: Move required facts forward; do not make one NPC, one roll, or one damage type the only door to the finale.
Respect player solutions that break the Core or sever Malakor's bond without contradicting the authored facts.
Failure changes cost, clock, position, or reward but should not stop the adventure.

routes.trigger: Kaelen is refused, unavailable, missing, or dead before the job is accepted.
routes.response: His four labeled harvest vials, payment ledger, and charcoal Hollow map remain on the apothecary counter; a town runner asks the party to investigate the black fog moving toward Oakhaven.
stateChanges: The quest can begin without Kaelen speaking.
clue-malakor-victim remains available from the grove.

routes.trigger: Malakor is attacked or treated as hostile before he can explain the corruption.
routes.response: The shrine inscription and the Heart Tree's black-root residue still reveal that the Core is the real anchor; when the Core breaks, Malakor's lucid interval exposes the cleanse option even if combat never pauses.
stateChanges: Combat does not remove the nonlethal option.

routes.trigger: The party bypasses or skips the Sunken Shrine.
routes.response: They can still enter through a cracked root tunnel. In the Heart Chamber Malakor's warning and visible fire-scarred root tissue reveal how to hurt the Core. The party loses Moonstone Resonance and the shrine loot.
stateChanges: Prepared payoff is lost, but the ending is not locked.

routes.trigger: The party reaches the Core with no practical fire or radiant damage.
routes.response: A broken moonstone shard at the chamber threshold can be pressed against the Core as an Action, dealing 1d6 radiant damage but forcing the user to make the root save immediately. This is slower and riskier than preparing at the shrine.
stateChanges: Rushed parties pay a tactical cost rather than getting stuck.

pathPressure.principle: Prepared play earns safer positioning and stronger tools; rushed play costs hit points, time, or resources, but the ending is never locked and the party can still finish.
prepared: Freeing the bear avoids its damage and demonstrates that corrupted creatures can be saved.
Solving the shrine cleanly grants Moonstone Resonance and the offering-alcove loot.
rushed: Crashing through razor-vines costs Dexterity saves and piercing damage.
Bypassing or forcing the shrine loses Moonstone Resonance and may advance the Shroud.

cutOrder: If the table is behind, resolve each rolled row in one sentence. Do not skip the return to Oakhaven or the lead into the next module.
If 20+ minutes behind, remove two Thorn-Shrubs and one Rot-Bloom from the Bramble Guard and start the bear adjacent to a character who can inspect its collar.
If 15+ minutes behind at the shrine, reveal the WHAT DIES FEEDS WHAT LIVES inscription immediately and allow one DC 13 bypass attempt.
Never cut the Core mechanic, the cleansing choice, or the eastern-watchtower reveal.
optionalOrder: Extended questioning of Kaelen before departure.
Searching every shrine offering niche after the listed cache is found.
Post-fight discussion with Malakor beyond the Module 03 reveal.

2014.label: 2014 SRD
tableNotes: The adventure's quick-run monster actions are self-contained and do not require a class build.
If you expand Malakor's named spells (Entangle, Thunderwave, Shillelagh), use the 2014 SRD spell text.

2024.label: 2024 SRD
tableNotes: The adventure's quick-run monster actions are self-contained and do not import 2014 class mechanics.
If you expand Malakor's named spells (Entangle, Thunderwave, Shillelagh), use the current SRD wording for the selected ruleset.

checks.label: Free the thorn-bound bear
checks.ability: Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Wisdom (Animal Handling)
checks.success: The thorn collar breaks or loosens; the bear immediately flees and no longer acts as an enemy.
checks.failure: The bear remains bound this round, but the character learns where the collar is weakest and may try again next turn.

checks.label: Read the moonstone cycle
checks.success: The glyphs clearly form Decay → Balance → Growth.
checks.failure: The inscription and mirror wear still point to the same order; no progress is blocked.

checks.label: Channel the sealed pillars
checks.success: The seal opens without aligning the mirrors.
checks.failure: Moonstone Backlash triggers, marks one Shroud surge, and the worn mirror tracks reveal the correct sequence.

checks.label: Cleansing action after the Core breaks
checks.ability: Intelligence (Arcana or Nature), Wisdom (Medicine or Religion), or Charisma (Persuasion)
checks.success: Mark one cleansing success; Malakor loses his next hostile action while fighting the corruption.
checks.failure: Mark one cleansing failure. At two failures he returns to full hostility, but the party may continue combat or devise another cleansing approach.

encounters.objective: Reach the shrine steps or neutralize the corrupted guard.
encounters.start: Party enters the west edge of an 80 × 40 ft. razor-vine lane.
encounters.bypass: Use Cautious Passage, open a gap, and reach the east shrine steps; freeing the bear removes it from combat.

creatures.name: Thorn-Shrub
creatures.statBlock: SRD Awakened Shrub, reskinned as blight-twisted thornbrush. Vulnerable to fire; resistant to piercing.
creatures.attack: Rake. Melee +1 to hit, reach 5 ft.; 1 (1d4 − 1) slashing.
creatures.trait: False Appearance: while motionless it is indistinguishable from ordinary brush.
creatures.edition2024: Rake +1 to hit, reach 5 ft.; 1 slashing. Same AC, HP, speed, fire vulnerability, and piercing resistance.
creatures.tactics: Crowd the first creature slowed by razor-vines so allies get a clear line; do not chase beyond the shrine steps.

creatures.name: Rot-Bloom
creatures.statBlock: SRD Violet Fungus, reskinned as a black-veined bloom rooted beside the lane. Blindsight 30 ft.
creatures.attack: Multiattack: 1d4 Rotting Touch attacks. Rotting Touch. Melee +2 to hit, reach 10 ft.; 4 (1d8) necrotic.
creatures.trait: False Appearance: while motionless it is indistinguishable from an ordinary fungus.
creatures.edition2024: Multiattack: two Rotting Touch attacks (+2 to hit, reach 10 ft.; 4 (1d8) necrotic).
creatures.tactics: Rooted beside the north brambles; lash anything that passes within 10 ft. They cannot pursue.

creatures.name: Bramble-Bound Bear
creatures.statBlock: SRD Black Bear (a thorn collar drives it; it is not evil).
creatures.attack: Multiattack: Bite +3 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing, and Claws +3 to hit, 2d4+2 slashing.
creatures.trait: Thorn-Bound: a successful collar check removes the bear from the encounter without reducing it to 0 HP. Keen Smell.
creatures.edition2024: Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft. Multiattack: two Rend attacks, +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing each.
creatures.tactics: Charge the nearest moving creature until freed; once the collar breaks, flee toward the west woods.

encounters.end: The party reaches the shrine steps, defeats the thorn-shrubs and rot-blooms, or otherwise opens a safe path.
encounters.balance: SRD 5.2.1 for 4 level-2 characters: Low 400, Moderate 600, High 800. Creature XP spent: 230, below the Low budget. Razor-vines add damage outside the creature XP. Introductory by design. SRD 5.1 prints monster XP and does not include an encounter-budget table, so this module does not invent a 2014 Easy/Medium/Hard/Deadly label.
encounters.scaling: 3 PCs: drop one Rot-Bloom (XP 180). 5 PCs: add one Rot-Bloom (XP 280). 6 PCs: add one Rot-Bloom and one Thorn-Shrub (XP 290). Low budget at level 2 is 100 XP per character. Stay under it.
encounters.balanceWhy: Razor-vines add damage outside the creature XP. Introductory by design.

encounters.objective: Break the Heart Tree Core, then defeat or cleanse Malakor.
encounters.start: Core AC 12 / 20 HP at the center; Malakor begins adjacent to it. Only fire or radiant damage hurts the Core.
encounters.bypass: A nonlethal cleanse is a full victory: after the Core breaks, score 3 DC 13 cleansing successes before 2 failures.

creatures.name: Heart Tree Core
creatures.immunities: All damage except fire and radiant.
creatures.trait: Object, not a creature: it has no turn and makes no saves. Shadow Ward: while the Core has HP, Malakor cannot be reduced below 1 HP.
creatures.tactics: The Core does not act; it powers the ward and root burst.
creatures.statBlock: Object, not a creature (AC 12, 20 HP). Immune to all damage except fire and radiant.

creatures.name: Malakor the Blight-Touched
creatures.attack: Blight Staff +4 to hit, 1d8+2 bludgeoning plus 1d4 necrotic.
creatures.ranged: Blight Bolt. Ranged spell attack +4 to hit, range 60 ft.; 1d10 necrotic.
creatures.action: Grasping Vines (Recharge 5–6): creatures in a 15-ft. square within 60 ft. make DC 12 Strength saves or become Restrained until the end of their next turns.
creatures.trait: Spell themes: Entangle, Thunderwave, Shillelagh. If you swap in full spellcasting, use the SRD Druid stat block for the selected edition and keep the Core rules.
creatures.tactics: Stay near the Core, restrain clustered intruders, then pressure whoever is dealing fire/radiant damage. After the Core breaks, lucid pauses make cleansing possible: he lowers the staff, repeats “Decay. Balance. Growth,” recognizes Kaelen’s name, and begs the party not to let the Hollow die.
creatures.statBlock: Original corrupted druid (not a Monster Manual reprint), built to CR 2 (450 XP) with the Core's protection.

creatures.name: Rot-Bloom (guarding the Core)
creatures.statBlock: SRD Violet Fungus, rooted 10 ft. from the Core.
creatures.attack: Multiattack: 1d4 Rotting Touch attacks. Rotting Touch. Melee +2 to hit, reach 10 ft.; 4 (1d8) necrotic.
creatures.tactics: Lashes anyone who steps next to the Core to attack it.

encounters.end: Core at 0 HP and Malakor defeated, or three cleansing successes are completed.
encounters.balance: SRD 5.2.1 for 4 level-2 characters: Low 400, Moderate 600, High 800. Creature XP spent: 500, between Low and Moderate. The Core's ward and the cleanse option make this harder in play than the creature XP alone. SRD 5.1 prints monster XP and does not include an encounter-budget table, so this module does not invent a 2014 Easy/Medium/Hard/Deadly label.
encounters.scaling: 3 PCs: remove the Rot-Bloom (XP 450, on the Low budget of 300 for three level-2 characters — still the finale). 5 PCs: two Rot-Blooms (XP 550) against Low 500. 6 PCs: two Rot-Blooms and Core 30 HP (XP 550) against Low 600.
encounters.balanceWhy: The Core's ward and the cleanse option make this harder in play than the creature XP alone.

hazards.trigger: Move through a razor-vine square without using Cautious Passage.
hazards.success: Take no damage and continue moving.
hazards.failForward: The creature still moves; spending an Action for Cautious Passage avoids further saves that turn.

hazards.trigger: Set the pillars in the wrong order or fail the channeling bypass.
hazards.save: DC 12 Constitution saving throw for creatures within 10 ft. of a pillar.
hazards.failure: Take 1d6 necrotic damage and mark one Shroud surge.
hazards.success: Take no damage, but mark one Shroud surge.
hazards.failForward: The backlash burns the correct Decay → Balance → Growth tracks into visible silver lines.

hazards.trigger: Initiative count 20 each round while the Core remains active.
hazards.save: DC 13 Strength saving throw for creatures on the ground.
hazards.failForward: A restrained creature or adjacent ally can spend an Action and succeed on DC 13 Strength (Athletics) to free it.

rewards.when: The party opens the Sunken Shrine alcove.
rewards.reward: Potion of Healing, Wand of Secrets (3 charges), and 25 gp in ancient silver.
Four Gloom-Lily Nectar vials; 150 gp total bounty; Potion of Greater Healing (SRD, 4d4+4 HP, consumed) if the grove is restored. The permanent item is the Wand of Secrets.

rewards.when: SHROUD reaches 3 before the Core breaks.
rewards.reward: Two Gloom-Lily Nectar vials and 75 gp; the Ring is not awarded.
Marked map pointing to caverns beneath Oakhaven's eastern watchtower.

features: Rot-Bloom positions behind the north brambles
four root lanes as difficult terrain

flowContract.principle: One clear route to the Heart Tree; the finale branches only on outcome.

clock.name: The Shroud
states: 0 — mist at the roots; full recovery possible
1 — fog at knee height after the Bramble Guard
2 — black condensation on the Heart Tree; full recovery still possible
3 — corruption settles into the root bed; the grove becomes a lasting dead zone

rulesEditions.carryForward: Level 2 sheets carry the Wand of Secrets on Ness Quinn.
rulesEditions.unsettled: SRD 5.1 has no encounter-budget table. Boots of Elvenkind attunement in SRD 5.1 was not re-read from a 5.1 PDF. Where a 2014 attack line is not copied, the scene says so and points at the 5.1 stat block.
